description: Seed KB for SHE v2 demo. Ingest sample-workspace/ first, then load this to add structured knowledge.

memories.title: Project Name
memories.content: SHE v2 — Structured Hierarchy Engine. A local coding agent with Group Memory knowledge base using PulseSeed structural resonance retrieval.

memories.title: Deploy Target
memories.content: Target deployment path is D:\AGI\she-v2. Designed for Windows with Node.js/TypeScript.

memories.title: KB Design Choice
memories.content: Group-structured knowledge base with PulseSeed retrieval instead of traditional vector RAG. Retrieval is structural resonance through groups and typed edges, not cosine similarity over embeddings.

memories.title: Edge Type Discipline
memories.content: Edge kinds are strictly distinct and never auto-promoted. co_occurrence records adjacency, temporal records order, causal_candidate requires direction + evidence + falsifiers. Weak edges are pre-activation hints only.

memories.title: Sandbox Model
memories.content: Windows Job Object sandbox with CWD jail, destructive command deny-list, and deny-by-default policy. On Linux: process groups as fallback.

memories.title: TypeScript Monorepo Structure
memories.content: packages/shared (types), packages/kb (Group KB engine), packages/agent-runtime (LLM + tools), packages/sandbox (shell isolation), packages/she-cli (CLI), packages/server (REST API), packages/ui (React)

memories.title: Module Style
memories.content: ESM-only (type: module). All relative imports use .js extensions for NodeNext resolution. Use import type for type-only imports.
